source: &1426 So Van der Waal had a hallucinatory freakout?
target: &1426 所以，范德瓦尔产生幻觉，发了狂？

source: &1046 Sounds like it was whatever he was putting in the wine.
target: &1046 听起来是他往酒里加的东西闹的。

source: &1047 We'd better find out what it was.
target: &1047 得查清楚他加了什么。

source: &182 Ooh, I know! I know everything about drinks!
target: &182 哦，我知道！酒水的事我全知道！

source: &183 Mr Giel was buying up cheap wine, and using wetware to artificially age it!
target: &183 吉尔先生买了一大堆便宜酒，再用湿件让酒快速陈化！

source: &1048 Wetware?
&184 Yeah, he kept it in the refrigerator!
target: &184 对呀，就放在冰箱里！

source: &1049 Ow, geez, what is that? Can't you hear it?
target: &1049 啊，天哪，那是什么？你听不见吗？

source: &394 What sits in the fridge is a memory module, with a strange configuration. Based on what you were told, you're certain this is what the blackmailer was after.
target: &394 冰箱里放着一个配置奇怪的记忆模块。根据勒索者告诉你的情况，你确信这就是对方想要的东西。

source: &185 There, the wetware on the middle shelf. It rapidly ages the wine to how it's wanted.
target: &185 就在那儿，中间那层架子上的湿件。它能让酒迅速陈化到想要的程度。

source: &1050 Not anymore it doesn't. It's been reprogrammed.
target: &1050 现在已经不能了。它的程序被改写了。

source: &1051 That memory module's broadcasting a signal.
target: &1051 那个记忆模块在发射信号。

source: &1052 The wetware in the refrigerator's interpreting it as an order to reformat itself...
target: &1052 冰箱里的湿件把信号当成了重新格式化自己的指令……

source: &1427 So, it stopped being a wine-aid, and ended up a powerful hallucinogen?
target: &1427 所以，它不再是酿酒助手，而变成了强效致幻剂？

source: &1053 Looks that way.
target: &1053 看来是这样。

source: &1428 You want me to carry it? You look uncomfortable.
target: &1428 要我拿着吗？你看着不太舒服。

source: &1054 Yeah, something about it...hurts...
target: &1054 嗯，不知道为什么，这东西……让我头疼……

source: &1429 We're heading back to CEL. A forensics team will be here in a while.
target: &1429 我们回 CEL 了。鉴证小组过一会儿会来。

source: &1430 Just don't try to make, cook or clean anything while we're gone, okay?
target: &1430 我们不在的时候，别制造、烹调或者清洁任何东西，好吗？

source: &187 I got it!
&1431 Giel? You in here?
target: &1431 吉尔？你在里面吗？

source: &1432 Oh, excuse us, Miss.
target: &1432 哦，打扰了，小姐。

source: &1433 I'm Dr Regis, this is Dr Lao. We're CEL agents.
target: &1433 我是里吉斯博士，这位是劳博士。我们是 CEL 探员。

source: &1434 ...Miss? Are you alright?
target: &1434 ……小姐？你还好吗？

source: &1055 Regis, this is a synth.
target: &1055 里吉斯，这是个合成人。

source: &1056 Hah, the look on your face is priceless.
target: &1056 哈，你刚才那表情，太精彩了。

source: &1057 It's a VERY expensive one, but it's still a synth...and apparently out of charge.
target: &1057 她是很贵，但也还是合成人……而且看来已经没电了。

source: &1435 Something else about it bothers me more...
target: &1435 我更担心的是另一件事……

source: &1058 I know...I sure hope that isn't blood...
target: &1058 我知道……我也希望那不是血……

source: &395 The now-breached door leads back out into the hallway.
target: &395 那扇已经打开的门通往外面的走廊。

source: &396 The darkened stone staircase leads to the upper floor of this apartment.
target: &396 深色的石阶通往这套公寓的上层。

source: &397 The cupboards containing the kitchen's various tools.[[You wonder for a moment whether the Van der Waals are extravagant enough to have paid for real, organic wood on the doors.
target: &397 橱柜里放着各种厨房用具。[[你不禁想，范德瓦尔夫夫会不会奢侈到用真正的天然木材做柜门。

source: &398 Much as you'd like to bring some order to the chaos, tidying up won't help anyone in this regard.
target: &398 你很想把这片混乱收拾得有条理些，可眼下整理东西帮不上忙。

source: &399 The rest of the cupboard is full of pipes connected to the food machine. Nothing useful remains.
target: &399 橱柜剩余的空间里，全是通往食品机的管道，已经没有能用的东西了。

source: &400 Aside from the pipes running to the food machine, the cabinet contains a set of knives, and a tube of cooking gel.
target: &400 除了通往食品机的管道，橱柜里还有一套刀具和一管烹饪凝胶。

source: Picked up:[Knife[Cooking Gel
target: 已拾取：[刀[烹饪凝胶

source: &401 The kitchen is furnished with a top-of-the-line food machine.
target: &401 厨房里装着一台顶级食品机。

source: &1436 Hey, this one makes its plates out of porcelain.
target: &1436 嘿，这台连盘子都是瓷的。

source: &1059 And in a place like this, I'll bet it doesn't even HAVE protein mash on its menu.
target: &1059 这种地方，我敢说菜单上连蛋白糊都不会有。

source: &402 There's no time to fix yourself a snack, unfortunately.
target: &402 可惜，现在没时间给自己做点吃的。

source: &403 Nothing happens. Apparently, taking its mind out has made it less talkative.
target: &403 毫无反应。看来，取走意识之后，它就没那么健谈了。

source: &404 The kitchen has a machine for preparing and serving drinks sitting in a nest of wine bottles.
target: &404 厨房里有一台制作、供应饮品的机器，周围摆满了酒瓶。

source: &405 There'd be nothing left to take, you've already cleared out its mind.
target: &405 没什么可拿的了，你已经把它的意识清空了。

source: &406 An antiquated PC terminal, built into an even older musical instrument.
target: &406 一台老式电脑终端，嵌在一件更老的乐器里。

source: &1060 Talk about anachronisms! I bet this thing still uses magnetic memory.
target: &1060 真是老古董！这东西该不会还用磁存储吧。

source: &1437 Can you breach it?
target: &1437 你能破解它吗？

source: &1061 Sorry, no can do. Anything before wetware isn't compatible with my wiring.
target: &1061 抱歉，办不到。湿件出现以前的东西，跟我的植入系统不兼容。

source: &1438 I guess that's one way of making it more secure...
target: &1438 这也算是提高安全性的一种办法吧……

source: &1439 Is this refrigerator...locked?
target: &1439 这个冰箱……上锁了？

source: &1440 Who the Hell locks a refrigerator?
target: &1440 谁会给冰箱上锁啊？

source: &1062 Maybe they've got really expensive tastes?
target: &1062 也许他们吃的东西特别贵？

source: The large refrigerator has a combination lock built into the door.
target: 这台大冰箱的门上装着密码锁。

source: &1441 That's not going to get it open.
target: &1441 这样打不开。

source: //ERROR: User Biometrics not recognized
target: //错误：无法识别用户生物特征

source: &1442 I don't think they're compatible.
target: &1442 我觉得它们不兼容。

source: &1443 It'd take a long time to get through all of that.
target: &1443 全查一遍，得花很长时间。

source: &1063 They've got a refined taste in wines, I imagine?
target: &1063 看来他们喝葡萄酒的品味很讲究？

source: &1444 Actually...no.
&1445 They're all either a couple of years old, or fabricated.
target: &1445 全都是才放了几年的酒，或者人工合成的。

source: &1064 Weird. Maybe they're doing something to the wine.
target: &1064 奇怪。也许他们往酒里加了什么。

source: &1065 Well, say they were also adding amphetamines to it, for example.
target: &1065 比如说，他们还往里面加安非他命。

source: &1066 If they accidentally ruined it, it'd be better if it was a cheaper wine.
target: &1066 万一不小心把酒糟蹋了，用便宜酒就没那么心疼。

source: &1068 Although, they've got the food machine as well...perhaps they've got something else in there?
target: &1068 不过他们也有食品机……冰箱里也许还放了别的东西？

source: &407 The large refrigerator has a combination lock built into the door.
target: &407 这台大冰箱的门上装着密码锁。

source: &336 Another example of questionable art hangs from the ceiling.
target: &336 天花板上还挂着一件品味可疑的艺术品。

source: &338 This one doesn't look like it has any useful components you can remove.
target: &338 这件东西看着没什么有用的零件能拆下来。
